subject: calderMobile

Category: Abstract.
Subject: hanging mobile.
Style: Alexander Calder.

spec.name: Calder Hanging Mobile
spec.description: A Calder-style hanging mobile: a ceiling hook and wire hang a three-tier balanced arrangement of black, red, yellow, blue and white sheet-metal leaves on thin wire arms.
spec.layout: The mobile hangs in the air, so there is no floor contact: its lowest leaf bottoms out near y=0.05 and nothing sits on the floor. A small ceiling hook (black) sits at the top at y=1.9 with a long thin black wire descending to the top arm at y=1.55. Tier 1 (top arm, y=1.55) is a long horizontal wire spanning x from -0.9 to 0.9 with a slight tilt. Its left end (+X) carries a big red disc leaf hanging on a short wire. Its right end (-X) wire drops to tier 2. Tier 2 (y=1.05, centred x=-0.7) is a wire arm spanning x from -1.1 to -0.3 and z a little forward and back. It carries a black teardrop leaf and a yellow oval leaf. Tier 3 hangs from the left end of tier 1 below the red disc side, at x=0.55, y=0.95, as an arm spanning x from 0.1 to 1.05 with a blue crescent leaf, a white small disc and a black fan leaf. All arms are thin cylinders of black wire (r about 0.006) with tiny loop eyelets at the joints. Leaves are flat extruded sheet shapes 0.01 to 0.015 thick, in organic Calder biomorphic outlines, each at a slightly different yaw angle so the mobile reads in 3D. Flat primary colours only, with no gradients. Tiny dark rivets or an offset white dot decorate some leaves. Leaves hang from wire stems of 0.1 to 0.35 m. Everything stays inside the size box.

parts.builds: Ceiling hook (small black ring and cap plate in ceiling grey), the long suspension wire from the hook to tier 1, the tier 1 arm wire with its eyelets, the two drop wires at its ends, and the big red disc leaf at the left end (+X) with a small white dot and a thin black rim sliver. Also a small orange counterweight ball at the right end.
parts.attaches: Starts at mount hook and ends at tier1Pivot. Drops wires at tier1Left (red disc, and a wire continuing down to tier3Pivot) and tier1Right (wire continuing down to tier2Pivot).

parts.builds: Tier 2: the wire arm hanging from tier1Right down to tier2Pivot, with a gently bent wire, a black teardrop leaf and a yellow oval leaf with a black dot, each on its own stem at a different yaw, plus a small red ball counterweight. All eyelets are tiny torus or ring shapes.
parts.attaches: Top of its hanging wire at tier1Right and arm centre at tier2Pivot.

parts.builds: Tier 3: the wire arm hanging from tier1Left down to tier3Pivot, carrying a blue crescent leaf, a small white disc and a black fan leaf on stems of differing lengths, with a yellow small ball counterweight and a tiny red dot detail on the blue leaf.
parts.attaches: Top of its hanging wire at tier1Left and arm centre at tier3Pivot.
